title: Sharplink
description: Institutional steel and sky: warm paper under a pale steel-blue wash, pure black text, pure black dark bands joined to the paper by tall blue gradients, and one electric blue for tiny marks and arrow boxes. Archivo at medium weight with tight tracking, narrow uppercase labels, square corners, no shadows.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark turns the paper black and the pale wash navy
primary and highlight are the electric blue (arrow boxes, section marks); glow is the mid blue of the gradient bands; accent is the pale steel wash
Archivo Variable is the original's own open-licence face; its width axis gives the narrow labels (font-stretch 80%)
name: sharplink-theme
